title: T-3 sole-reader-scan probe surfaces every non-facade module that dereferences env.CELL or env.HUB
asA: reviewer enforcing the sole-reader guarantee on env.CELL and env.HUB
iWant: the sole-reader-scan probe to walk every .mjs/.js/.ts file under the fixture applied source root and assert only src/do-facade.mjs dereferences env.CELL or env.HUB in live source
soThat: a legacy call site or an accidental new one surfaces at self-review, not at runtime

acceptanceCriteria.description: The sole-reader-scan probe reads every .mjs/.js/.ts file under packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/cf-platform/src, strips block and line comments, matches literal env.CELL and env.HUB and reports every non-facade file with a live match as a leak. The clean-fixture scan surfaces zero leaks. Under SIMULATE_NON_FACADE_IMPORT=true a scratch leaker at $TMPDIR/t3-sole-reader-scratch is included in the scan; the scan surfaces the leak and returns fail.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the cf-platform fixture applied source root, and optionally the SIMULATE_NON_FACADE_IMPORT switch
acceptanceCriteria.then: clean scan returns pass with zero leaks; simulate scan surfaces the injected leaker and returns fail
